status: C52 library and synthetic native ext4 laboratory passed; real card audit read-only
platform_guard_required: C20/C22 pinned test128 card, UUID, ext4 mount identity, private namespace, lifetime lock, global root ro; preserve preferences

directory.marker_initialization_and_sync: caller must initialize exclusively and fsync marker and parent directories before first durable use

identity: 64 lowercase hex characters, caller derives from a versioned domain plus exact private ROM and core SHA256; do not publish commercial identity

quicksave.state.validation: PKST v1, flags0, no achievements, exact length and core CRC32

states.ini.validation: nonempty text, no NUL, quicksave group; C51 inspector additionally validates required fields

quicksave.png.validation: PNG signature only, not complete image decoding

sources_and_exports: preexisting root-owned 0700 tmpfs directories; export must be empty; no metadata or raw state sent to host
bundle: MUOSSAV1, 128-byte header, version1, three little-endian lengths and CRC32 values, identity, reserved zero bytes, exact three payloads
head: canonical MUOS-SAVE-HEAD-1 text with IDENTITY, CURRENT, PREVIOUS and NEXT; publication by exclusive staging, file fsync, rename and directory fsync
commit: exclusive nonblocking flock; immutable exclusive generation file, file fsync, store-directory fsync, then publish HEAD
recovery: explicit recover validates PREVIOUS before publishing it as CURRENT, clears PREVIOUS and preserves NEXT and all generation files

failure_policy.invalid_current: refuse unchanged; no automatic fallback or defaults
failure_policy.before_head_rename: old HEAD retained; completed orphan generation may remain and blocks same NEXT; never adopt or delete automatically
failure_policy.after_head_rename_directory_sync_failure: return74, new HEAD may be visible, durability unknown; no automatic rollback
failure_policy.generation_limit: return73 without overwriting current or previous generations
failure_policy.export_failure: remove only exclusively created files from this invocation; successful export is still RAM-only

exit_codes.3: absent head, generation or previous snapshot; never interpret as authorization to reset

remaining: native game checkpoint across separate sessions
